messages:
Avery: Thanks for joining the all-hands — follow-up thread for questions we didn't get to about hiring and org changes. Drop clarifying Qs here and @Sam or @Priya will respond.
Jordan: Quick one — can you confirm whether the platform team split still goes ahead in Q3, or was that paused?
Sam: Not paused. Platform split is proceeding but staggered hiring. We'll prioritize infra-critical roles first (autoscaling, runtime reliability).
Marta: Any rough numbers for headcount increases per org? curious for planning allocations.
Priya: Rough high level: targeting ~15 net new IC hires in Q3 across Eng (8), Infra/Platform (5), and SRE/Service Reliability (2). These are hiring targets not offers — still flexible.
Rui: Are we opening new senior IC reqs or mostly L3-L4?
Sam: Mix — we want a couple of senior ICs (L5) for runtime and one staff/pipeline role if we find the right fit. Bulk will be mid-level (L3-L4).
Jordan: How will the split affect on-call and ownership? will teams inherit SLAs per new structure?
Priya: Teams will inherit current product SLAs; on-call rotations will be preserved but ownership boundaries change. We'll publish a new on-call map and escalation doc next week.
Marta: For folks impacted by org moves, will there be role guarantees / relocation offers?
Sam: No blanket relocations. Most moves are lateral; we will offer transition support and role-level mapping. If a move requires relocation we'll work case-by-case.
Jordan: Is there any hiring freeze for non-customer-facing roles during the transition?
Sam: No freeze. We are being conservative with headcount spend but still filling prioritized roles.
Avery: One more clarification — Dedicated and Private product hiring is higher priority for next two quarters due to enterprise deals. That means platform and infra hiring may be accelerated if sales needs it.
Rui: Any change to internship/new grad plans?
Sam: We still plan to run a small intern program this summer — headcount minimal but we expect 2-3 interns in Eng. Applications to be posted in Workable by end of month.
Marta: Great — will you share the hiring map and a list of prioritized roles?
Priya: Yes — we're compiling a public hiring map (teams, role priorities, roughly expected close windows). Aim to share by Friday: link will be posted here.
All-Hands Bot: Poll: "Do you feel the org changes are clear after today's all-hands?" — react with :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:. Poll open for 48h.
Jordan: Thanks — appreciate the transparency.
Avery: Thanks, everyone. If you have private concerns or impacts, please ping @Sam or DM me.
